title: RYAN ARNAB IDENTITY SYSTEM
desc: Personal visual identity and geometric monogram mark system exploring kinetic grid structures and gold accents.

narrative.objective: To engineer an authoritative personal visual identity and monogram mark that harmonizes razor-sharp modernist geometry with dynamic negative space.
narrative.architecture: Constructed on interlocking diagonal axes evoking the letterforms 'R' and 'A', paired with a solar gold and deep void dark-mode color taxonomy.
narrative.impact: Established as the hallmark signature across all digital platforms, physical portfolio presentations, and personal stationery.

title: KOKUYO CAMEL TYPEFACE REDESIGN
desc: A custom display typeface redesign (CAMEL.TTF) and comprehensive type specimen crafted for Kokuyo Camel.

narrative.objective: To modernize Kokuyo Camel's legendary stationery heritage into an expressive display font family that bridges analog warmth with contemporary geometric precision.
narrative.architecture: Forged with extreme stroke contrast, high ascenders, and geometric ink-traps optimized for large-scale packaging, posters, and digital display environments.
narrative.impact: Adopted as the foundational display typeface for brand campaigns, premium stationery packaging, and international retail promotions.
